privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Make Art Matter Inc. ("Matr Labs," "we," "us," or "our") operates matr.art and is committed to handling personal information responsibly.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, when we share it, and the choices available to you.

Our goal is simple: we collect and use personal information primarily to provide the products and services you request, and we do not sell your personal information or use your customer artwork to train AI or machine-learning models.

blocks.text: Depending on how you interact with matr.art, we may collect the following categories of information.
This may include:

items: Name
Email address
Billing and shipping address
Telephone number, where provided
Order and purchase information
Communications you send to us
Newsletter and marketing preferences
Information submitted through customer service requests
Artwork or other files you upload for an order

blocks.text: Payments are processed through Shopify and its applicable payment providers.
We do not store your full payment card number or other complete payment credentials on our own systems.
When you visit matr.art, we and our service providers may collect technical information such as:

items: IP address
Browser and device information
Pages viewed
Approximate interaction and usage information
Referring pages
Timestamps
Information collected through cookies and similar technologies

blocks.text: Some of this information may be collected automatically by Shopify, analytics providers, hosting providers, security services, or other technology providers supporting the site.
We use personal information only for legitimate purposes related to operating Matr Labs and providing our services.
These purposes include:

items: Processing and fulfilling orders
Producing and shipping your artwork
Communicating with you about your order
Providing customer support
Processing payments through our payment providers
Handling returns, replacements, refunds, and damaged-order claims
Maintaining records necessary for accounting, tax, legal, and regulatory requirements
Preventing fraud, abuse, unauthorized activity, and security incidents
Maintaining and securing our website and systems
Diagnosing and fixing technical problems
Understanding basic website usage and improving site functionality
Sending marketing or newsletter communications where you have opted in or where otherwise permitted by applicable law
Complying with legal obligations and responding to valid legal requests

blocks.text: We do not use customer personal information for unrelated purposes.
We do not sell your personal information.
We do not use your uploaded artwork to train artificial intelligence or machine-learning models.
If you sign up for our newsletter or otherwise provide the required consent to receive marketing communications, we may send you occasional updates about Matr Labs, products, or related news.
You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by using the unsubscribe mechanism included in the email or by contacting us at hello@matr.art.

Transactional communications — such as order confirmations, shipping updates, and messages necessary to fulfill or support an order — may still be sent even if you unsubscribe from marketing communications.
We use cookies and similar technologies that are necessary for the operation of matr.art, including features such as shopping cart functionality and checkout.
We may also use analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site and to help us improve its performance and functionality.
Depending on the tools and settings we use, analytics technologies may collect information such as device information, pages viewed, interactions, and approximate usage information.
Where required by applicable law, we will provide appropriate notice and choices regarding non-essential cookies and similar technologies.
You can also control cookies through your browser or device settings.
We do not sell your personal information.
We may share personal information with trusted service providers when doing so is necessary to operate Matr Labs or provide a service you have requested.
These providers may include:
Shopify provides our ecommerce platform, checkout, payment processing infrastructure, order management, and related services.
Supabase provides database and related infrastructure services that we use to operate aspects of our website and business systems.
Vercel provides hosting and infrastructure services for aspects of our website.
Cloudflare provides domain, DNS, security, performance, and related infrastructure services.
We may provide necessary order information to fulfillment, packaging, and shipping partners so that your order can be produced, packaged, delivered, or otherwise supported.
This may include Shopify's fulfillment services and service providers assisting Matr Labs with packaging and shipping, including BluEdge where applicable.
We may share or permit access to limited information with providers that help us understand site usage, maintain security, or operate technical systems.
We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to:

items: Comply with applicable law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request
Protect the rights, property, or safety of Matr Labs, our customers, or others
Detect, investigate, or prevent fraud, abuse, security incidents, or illegal activity
Enforce our agreements
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims

blocks.text: Your uploaded artwork belongs to you.
We use uploaded artwork only as reasonably necessary to process and fulfill your order and provide related customer service.
We do not sell your artwork.
We do not use your artwork to train artificial intelligence or machine-learning models.
We do not use your artwork for unrelated commercial purposes.

Once your order has been completed and the artwork is no longer reasonably necessary for production or customer support, we intend to delete the uploaded artwork from our active systems, subject to technical backup cycles and any retention required for legal, accounting, security, or dispute-resolution purposes.

We may retain limited non-image production records associated with an order, such as an order number, product specifications, production date, and other information necessary to document the transaction and operate our business.
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy.
For example, we may retain order and transaction information for as long as necessary to:

items: Fulfill and document an order
Provide customer service
Process returns, refunds, replacements, or disputes
Comply with tax, accounting, legal, or regulatory obligations
Prevent fraud and maintain security
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims

blocks.text: Customer-uploaded artwork is intended to be deleted after it is no longer needed for production or customer support, subject to applicable backup systems and legal requirements.
When information is no longer needed, we may delete it, anonymize it, or securely dispose of it.
We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Access to customer information should be limited to people and service providers who reasonably need it to perform their responsibilities.
Depending on where you live and applicable law, you may have rights concerning your personal information, including rights to:

items: Request access to personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate information
Request deletion of personal information
Request information about how we collect or disclose personal information
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
Unsubscribe from marketing communications
Exercise other rights provided by applicable law

blocks.text: To make a privacy request, contact us at hello@matr.art.
We may need to verify your identity before completing certain requests.
We will respond to valid requests within the time required by applicable law.
matr.art is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 18.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 for the purpose of allowing them to independently purchase our products.
If you believe that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at hello@matr.art.
Our website depends on third-party services, and those providers may process information according to their own privacy policies and terms.

These providers may include Shopify, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, payment providers, analytics providers, fulfillment providers, shipping carriers, and other service providers that help us operate Matr Labs.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of relevant third-party providers.
Our service providers may process or store information in locations outside the state or country where you live.
Where applicable, we and our service providers will take steps required by law concerning the transfer and processing of personal information.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our business, technology, services, or legal obligations.
When we make changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this Policy.
We encourage you to review this Policy periodically.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, your personal information, or a privacy request, contact:
Make Art Matter Inc. — hello@matr.art
